label: Permit records — City of Rock Island
source_note: Extracted from 111 City of Rock Island monthly PDF permit reports at https://rigov.org/1276/Permit-Reports, covering 2017-01 to 2026-04. The other fifteen permit jurisdictions in Rock Island County are documented on the Sources page; none of them was harvested, and a parcel with no permits found here is not a parcel with no permits.
records_note: Showing the 250 most recent of 25,354 extracted permit records, newest permit date first. The full set is loaded in the pipeline database and committed under data/artifacts/permits/ — it is not shipped to the browser. Every count on this page is over all 25,354 records, not over the 250 rows shown.

linkage.method_statement: Permits are joined to parcels on the identifier the source printed, in three tiers. Tier 1: the EnerGov reports (2026-04 onward) print the 10-digit county PIN, matched exactly after left-padding a dropped leading zero. Tier 2: the legacy reports (2017-01 to 2026-03) print a TAX_MAP number, matched exactly against the parcel layer's RICO_PARCE legacy identifier. Tier 3: remaining records are matched on a normalised site address. Address matching is the fallback, not the method, and the parcel layer's site_address is itself only 88.91% populated.
linkage.limits_statement: A permit that did not match is not a permit without a parcel. Unmatched records fall into stated categories, including source sentinel values such as 000000 and RIGHT-OF-WAY that are not parcel references at all, and legacy keys for parcels that appear to have since been split or retired. Matching is to the parcel layer as it stands today, not as it stood when the permit was issued.
